newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian soldier shot dead in Tajik capital.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldier shot dead in Tajik capital.

text.p: A Russian soldier based in Tajikistan was shot dead on the outskirts of the capital Dushanbe, the former Soviet republic's interior ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry's press service said 23-year-old Vitaly Lisovsky, with Russia's 201st motorised infantry brigade, was shot in the head by an unidentified assailant with a pistol late on Tuesday.
The killing follows a spate of attacks on Russian servicemen in the remote, mountainous country, widely blamed on Islamist opposition guerrillas.
Thousands of Russian troops are on peacekeeping duties in the war-torn republic and guard its southern border with Afghanistan. They also prop up Tajik President Imomali Rakhmonov's shaky government.

A four-year civil war between the secular government and the Islamist guerrillas has left tens of thousands dead and displaced many more. Rakhmonov is scheduled to sign a peace agreement with opposition leader Sayid Abdullo Nuri in Moscow next week.
